A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''Rodian''' was a member of [[the Doomed]] on [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]]. He died fighting one of [[Remulus Dreypa|Dreypa's]] [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathans]] during the [[Battle of Sessal Spire]] in [[2974 BBY]].

==Biography==
This [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] was a member of [[the Doomed]], a [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] order which consisted of the descendants of former [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] and [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] who had become stranded on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Kesh/Legends|Kesh]] following the [[Hundred-Year Darkness/Legends|Hundred-Year Darkness]]. The Doomed resided in [[Eshkrene]], the planet's southern polar continent away from the native [[Keshiri/Legends|Keshiri]] and the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Lost Tribe of Sith|Sith Tribe]] which settled on Kesh' continent of [[Keshtah Minor]] during the [[Great Hyperspace War/Legends|Great Hyperspace War]]. He lived in the [[City of the Doomed]], a settlement which was home to the Doomed community. The Doomed consisted of individuals from a wide range of species including [[S'kytri]], Rodians, [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiees]], [[Chagrian/Legends|Chagrians]], [[Twi'lek/Legends|Twi'leks]], [[Ithorian/Legends|Ithorians]], and [[Weequay/Legends|Weequays]]. All members of the Doomed committed themselves to finding a balance between the [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light]] and [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark]] sides of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]]. There were at least [[Unidentified Rodian Doomed member|two other Rodian members]] of the Doomed community.<ref name="Spiral 2">[[Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral 2|''Lost Tribe of the Sith — Spiral'' 2]]</ref>

In [[2974 BBY]], he participated during the [[Battle of Sessal Spire]]. Following the awakening of the ancient [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Remulus Dreypa]], the Doomed managed to obtain a herd of [[uvak]]s, winged flying beasts, and flew to [[Keshtah Minor]] in pursuit of Dreypa. The Doomed managed to rain down arrows on Dreypa and his [[Leviathan (creature)|Leviathan]] [[Sithspawn/Legends|sithspawn]], vast reptilian beasts capable of draining the life force of sentient beings. However, Dreypa fought back with [[Force lightning/Legends|Force lightning]] and his leviathans managed to capture and devour many of the Doomed and their uvak steeds. This Rodian was among those captured by the Leviathans and was drained of his life energies.<ref name="Spiral 4" />

Prior to his death, this Rodian Doomed member managed to confront Dreypa. Based on the life forces drained from the Doomed, Dreypa learnt about their identity and origins. While he knew that the Doomed had pledged never to make war again near the Keshiri, he did not know why they had returned to Keshtah Minor. The Rodian responded that there was only peace while Dreypa was sealed within his [[Oubliette (stasis casket)|oubliette]]. He also denounced Dreypa as his great shame and stated that it had to be put right. In response, Dreypa stated that he would put all of the Doomed right one at a time. He then sensed that the Doomed were [[Last Hope (Jedi starship)|hiding something]] from him and vowed to find out what it was. Dreypa then departed and left the Rodian Doomed member to die. Ultimately, Dreypa was defeated by the two members of the Lost Tribe, [[Parlan Spinner]] and [[Takara Hilts]], at the [[Siege of Tahv]].<ref name="Spiral 4" />
